title: Understanding Financial Goals
content: A financial goal is a target or objective that an individual plans to achieve through financial management and saving. Financial goals are categorized by time horizon into short-term (under 1 year, such as emergency fund or vacation), medium-term (1 to 5 years, such as buying a vehicle or house down payment), and long-term (over 5 years, such as retirement or child education). Effective financial goals follow SMART criteria: Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound.
